name: You Are The Company You Keep
notes:
This virtual group started on Friday, March 13, 2020 as a result of COVID shutdown by 12 close LGBT+ & Straight Sober friends & fellows from around the globe. Just like AA's tradition, this meeting grew from attraction, not promotion. The only requirement for AA membership is a desire to stop drinking! The only requirement to join this meeting is active participation in our continuous review and practical application of the 12 Steps found in our basic text and the first 164 Pages of the Big Book and all approved AA Literature. This Group focuses on "Into Action" - Not Into Feelings or Thinking. Meetings are 7 days a week – Same Time – Same Meeting Link – Different Format Every Day: Sunday - Prayer & Meditation Monday - Wheel of Sobriety Tuesday - Cross Talk Wednesday - As Bill Sees It Thursday - The Long Haul Friday - Random / Random Saturday - Week in Review

name: The Last House On The Block
Sunset Serenity
notes:
Saturday Serenity is an open dual?diagnosis AA meeting where we honor the whole person — mind, body, and spirit. This is a space for anyone living with alcoholism and mental health challenges, or simply seeking a gentler landing place at the end of the week. We show up as we are, we share from the heart, and we support each other with honesty, compassion, and courage. Our format rotates to keep the room alive and connected: • Share Nights where we speak our truth and listen with respect • Speaker Nights featuring experience, strength, and hope from inside and outside the group • Music Nights where recovery meets rhythm, reflection, and joy • The AA Wheel, offering a guided, balanced way to explore different aspects of the program Whether you’re brand new, returning, or continuing your journey, Saturday Serenity is a place where your presence matters. We believe recovery is richer when we walk it together — with openness, creativity, and a willingness to grow. Come as you are. Stay as long as you need. Welcome home, welcome forward, welcome together.

name: Insomniaa
notes:
InsomniAA is a warm, inclusive, and open zoom meeting of Alcoholics Anonymous for newcomers and oldtimers alike at 11:30 p.m. PST in the USA every night. We embrace all with open arms and offer support to those seeking sobriety on their journey to recovery. No one is ever turned away; all that is required to participate is the desire to stop drinking. Our primary purpose is to stay sober and help other alcoholics achieve sobriety, and we are committed to adhering to the 12 Traditions of A.A. Welcome! name: Freethinkers
notes:
● Face masks required for unvaccinated attendees

Meeting Format: A round-robin reading of A.A. literature with and without comment by the reader, followed in the second half, by a general discussion of A.A. related topics.

This group of A.A. attempts to maintain a tradition of free expression, and conducts a meeting where alcoholics may feel free to express any doubts or disbelief's they may have, and to share their own personal form of spiritual experience, their search for it, or their rejection of it. We do not endorse or oppose any form of religion or atheism. Our only wish is to assure suffering alcoholics that they can find sobriety in A.A. without having to accept anyone else's beliefs or having to deny their own.

name: Sunset Serenity
notes:
Saturday Serenity is an open dual?diagnosis AA meeting where we honor the whole person — mind, body, and spirit. This is a space for anyone living with alcoholism and mental health challenges, or simply seeking a gentler landing place at the end of the week. We show up as we are, we share from the heart, and we support each other with honesty, compassion, and courage. Our format rotates to keep the room alive and connected: • Share Nights where we speak our truth and listen with respect • Speaker Nights featuring experience, strength, and hope from inside and outside the group • Music Nights where recovery meets rhythm, reflection, and joy • The AA Wheel, offering a guided, balanced way to explore different aspects of the program Whether you’re brand new, returning, or continuing your journey, Saturday Serenity is a place where your presence matters. We believe recovery is richer when we walk it together — with openness, creativity, and a willingness to grow. Come as you are. Stay as long as you need. Welcome home, welcome forward, welcome together.

name: You Are The Conpany You Keep
notes:
This virtual group started on Friday, March 13, 2020 as a result of COVID shutdown by 12 close LGBT+ & Straight Sober friends & fellows from around the globe. Just like AA's tradition, this meeting grew from attraction, not promotion. The only requirement for AA membership is a desire to stop drinking! The only requirement to join this meeting is active participation in our continuous review and practical application of the 12 Steps found in our basic text and the first 164 Pages of the Big Book and all approved AA Literature. This Group focuses on "Into Action" - Not Into Feelings or Thinking. Meetings are 7 days a week – Same Time – Same Meeting Link – Different Format Every Day: Sunday - Prayer & Meditation Monday - Wheel of Sobriety Tuesday - Cross Talk Wednesday - As Bill Sees It Thursday - The Long Haul Friday - Random / Random Saturday - Week in Review

name: AA After Hours
notes:
A daily online support Zoom meeting with readings & open discussion from The Daily Reflection, AA Big Book, & more. We are not a glum lot. Grounded in the Steps & Traditions of AA, we share our Experience Strength & Hope with Newcomers & Old Timers alike.

Tradition #3 in Alcoholics Anonymous states, "The only requirement for membership is the desire to stop drinking." Open to all; everyone is welcome to attend. Meets daily from 7 pm to 10 pm USA PST. If you want to get sober or if you’re feeling tempted, talk with us. If you just want to listen in, come on in.

Week 2: Watching AA related videos on the step
Week 3: Speaker meeting
Week 4: Open discussion

name: You Are The Company You Keep
notes:
This virtual group started on Friday, March 13, 2020 as a result of COVID shutdown by 12 close LGBT+ & Straight Sober friends & fellows from around the globe. Just like AA's tradition, this meeting grew from attraction, not promotion. The only requirement for AA membership is a desire to stop drinking! The only requirement to join this meeting is active participation in our continuous review and practical application of the 12 Steps found in our basic text and the first 164 Pages of the Big Book and all approved AA Literature. This Group focuses on "Into Action" - Not Into Feelings or Thinking. Meetings are 7 days a week – Same Time – Same Meeting Link – Different Format Every Day: Sunday - Prayer & Meditation Monday - Wheel of Sobriety Tuesday - Cross Talk Wednesday - As Bill Sees It Thursday - The Long Haul Friday - Random / Random Saturday - Week in Review

The 22:22 Gratitude Meeting is a nightly AA gathering held at 10:22 PM, where members from all walks of recovery come together to close the day in gratitude. name: Insomniaa
notes:
InsomniAA is a warm, inclusive, and open zoom meeting of Alcoholics Anonymous for newcomers and oldtimers alike at 11:30 p.m. PST in the USA every night. We embrace all with open arms and offer support to those seeking sobriety on their journey to recovery. No one is ever turned away; all that is required to participate is the desire to stop drinking. Our primary purpose is to stay sober and help other alcoholics achieve sobriety, and we are committed to adhering to the 12 Traditions of A.A. Welcome! We have a different format each night and always leave time for open discussion. Questions? Contact us at insomniAA2024@gmail.com.

name: You Are The Company You Keep
notes:
This virtual group started on Friday, March 13, 2020 as a result of COVID shutdown by 12 close LGBT+ & Straight Sober friends & fellows from around the globe. Just like AA's tradition, this meeting grew from attraction, not promotion. The only requirement for AA membership is a desire to stop drinking! The only requirement to join this meeting is active participation in our continuous review and practical application of the 12 Steps found in our basic text and the first 164 Pages of the Big Book and all approved AA Literature. This Group focuses on "Into Action" - Not Into Feelings or Thinking. Meetings are 7 days a week – Same Time – Same Meeting Link – Different Format Every Day: Sunday - Prayer & Meditation Monday - Wheel of Sobriety Tuesday - Cross Talk Wednesday - As Bill Sees It Thursday - The Long Haul Friday - Random / Random Saturday - Week in Review

name: You Are The Company You Keep
notes:
This virtual group started on Friday, March 13, 2020 as a result of COVID shutdown by 12 close LGBT+ & Straight Sober friends & fellows from around the globe. Just like AA's tradition, this meeting grew from attraction, not promotion. The only requirement for AA membership is a desire to stop drinking! The only requirement to join this meeting is active participation in our continuous review and practical application of the 12 Steps found in our basic text and the first 164 Pages of the Big Book and all approved AA Literature. This Group focuses on "Into Action" - Not Into Feelings or Thinking. Meetings are 7 days a week – Same Time – Same Meeting Link – Different Format Every Day: Sunday - Prayer & Meditation Monday - Wheel of Sobriety Tuesday - Cross Talk Wednesday - As Bill Sees It Thursday - The Long Haul Friday - Random / Random Saturday - Week in Review

name: Speakers through Speakers Online
notes:
Speakers Through Speakers is a weekly meeting of Alcoholics Anonymous. Each week we digitally convert and listen to an old AA speaker tape that was sent to us, making sure the sound quality is okay and noting any anonymity breaks to edit out, we then upload the talk to the internet, thus saving it for future generations of AAs. Our mission is to save these old talks, that carry the message so well, that might otherwise have been lost.

• There is a brief participation portion at each meeting, please take notes of your favorite parts / ideas / principles etc. during a talk to share about later.
* Please turn on your camera when entering the meeting to help us know you're not a bomber.

• If you or someone you know has a bunch of old AA speaker cassettes that might not be online yet, or you're interested in helping convert tapes or starting another STS mtg on another night, please email speakersthroughspeakers@gmail.com
